Name: Giant Crop
Author: Yaolurk
Description:
● Press a configurable hotkey (default: F6) to instantly grow a giant crop from any 3×3 grid of the same crop.

  ## How to use
  1. Plant a 3×3 grid of cauliflower, melon, pumpkin, powdermelon, or Qi fruit.
  2. Point your cursor at the top-left tile of the 3×3 grid.
  3. Press F6.

  The 3×3 crops will be replaced by a giant crop.

  ## Supported crops
  - Cauliflower
  - Melon
  - Pumpkin
  - Powdermelon
  - Qi Fruit

  ## Requirements
  - Stardew Valley 1.6+
  - SMAPI 4.0+

  ## Optional
  - [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) — lets you rebind the hotkey in-game.

  ## Translation
  - English
  - 中文
